timestamp_meaning: Candle opening time; no further MT4 server offset correction
format: RFC4180-compatible CSV with LF, gzip without LFS
prices: Original canonical decimal strings; no rounding, filtering or resampling
quote_basis: Canonical Phoenix OHLC; separate bid/ask and spread are not supplied
tick_volume: Source tick count; not monetary trading volume
missing_policy: No filling or intersection. Calendar absences include closed-market time; cause is not inferred
snapshot: Single repeatable-read, read-only PostgreSQL snapshot; only closed bars before fixed cutoff
